name: FreeRTOS LVGL designer project
description: Create complex user interfaces for 32-bit microcontrollers with the powerful LVGL library, driven by a FreeRTOS LVGL task.
files_included:
**CMakeLists.txt:** Configuration file for building your project.
**main.c:** Entry point that starts the FreeRTOS scheduler.
**app/app_freertos.c:** LVGL task driving lv_tick_inc, touch polling and rendering.
**app/app_freertos.h:** Task declarations.
**config/FreeRTOSConfig.h:** FreeRTOS kernel configuration.
**main_screen.mscr:** A blank main screen.
**main_screen.c:** Source file with code for screen initialization.
outputs:
**.hex:** Hexadecimal binary for MCU flashing.
**.bin:** Raw binary for various deployment options.
requirements:
mikroSDK
Clock: > 64 MHz
Flash/ROM: > 200 kB
RAM: > 48 kB
Requires the FreeRTOS package to be added via the Library Manager before building.
